title: Best Restaurant Denver: restaurant data
license: Facts compiled by BestRestaurantDenver.com from the cited public sources. You may quote and link with attribution to https://bestrestaurantdenver.com/. Award levels belong to MICHELIN and the James Beard Foundation.
notes: Every record lists its sources and the date we last checked it ("verified").
We publish no ratings, reviews, prices or hours. hours/price/phone are null unless sourced.
lat/lng are null: coordinates have not yet been geocoded from a recorded source (US Census Geocoder or OpenStreetMap). Use the address.
editor_tags are our own rule-based labels (see /editorial-policy/), not claims by the restaurants.
track: michelin = 2026 MICHELIN Guide Colorado; press = James Beard or long-running Denver institution with independent press coverage; bar = cocktail bar.

restaurants.note: Founded in 1893 and widely described as Denver's oldest restaurant; it holds Colorado liquor license No. 1 and is on the National Register of Historic Places.
